Nine application files and one test file import from the rate limiter, `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`:

- **The consume function (`consumeRateLimit`) only:** `src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts`, the four services (`auth-service`, `comment-service`, `invitation-service`, `search-service`), and the actions `login.ts`, `reset-password.ts`, `create-comment.ts` and `invite-member.ts`.
- **Everything else (`RATE_LIMIT_BUCKETS`, `getBucketConfig`, `resetRateLimits`, `setOrgPlan`):** only `tests/lib/rate-limit.test.ts`, which also imports `consumeRateLimit`.

I left out four test files: `plan-limits.test.ts`, `comment-service.test.ts`, `invitation-service.test.ts` and `search-service.test.ts`. They only use `vi.mock("@/lib/rate-limit", ...)` to swap in a stand-in from `tests/server/_support/doubles/misc.ts`, and never import the real module. I also left out `webhooks.ts` and `action-errors.ts`, which only mention the module in comments.

ANSWER: src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/auth-service.ts, src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts, src/actions/auth/reset-password.ts, src/actions/auth/login.ts, src/actions/members/invite-member.ts, tests/lib/rate-limit.test.ts
